summary: Full CTA audit of the landing page + main marketing pages on https://dynopay-setup-8.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend only, Playwright). Clicked 14 header mega-menu items, header logo / Sign in / Start free / mega-featured CTA, hero claim input+button and hero card CTA, all 4 audience doors, all 3 product feature cards, all 3 Learn/Docs cards, FAQ help link, both Final-CTA buttons, all 14 internal footer links, and the primary CTAs on /fees, /for/merchants, /about, /customers, /documentation. RESULT: 100% of the audited CTAs navigate to a working (HTTP 200, non-blank, non-404) page or perform their intended in-page scroll. The two newly added anchors (/#features -> scrollY 0->2115, /#use-cases -> 0->1125) scroll correctly. Mobile (390x844) hamburger menu + hero claim also verified working. Both requested regressions PASS (minicart FAB clickable and drawer opens; socials label reads 'FIND THE DEV STORE ON'). The user's 'majority of CTAs not working' report could NOT be reproduced on this URL. Two genuine, unrelated overlay/duplication defects were found around the bottom-right floating buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: OVERLAY BLOCKS CLICK: the global 'Scroll to top' IconButton is fixed at bottom:32/right:24 with zIndex = theme.zIndex.tooltip + 1 (~1501), which sits ON TOP of the support-chat FAB (zIndex 1451, bottom-right, 56x56). Whenever the page is scrolled >300px, elementFromPoint at the chat FAB centre returns the 'Scroll to top' button and a normal Playwright click on [data-testid=support-chat-button] times out (BLOCKED). Reproduced on /, /fees and /documentation at 1920x1080. Fix: offset the scroll-to-top button (e.g. bottom: 100) or lower its zIndex below 1451.

DUPLICATE CONTROL: /documentation renders its own 'Back to top' Fab (aria-label='Back to top', rect 1856,944) in addition to the global 'Scroll to top' button (1856,1008) — two identical stacked up-arrow buttons in the bottom-right corner (visible in screenshot). Remove the page-local one.

On mobile the global scroll-to-top button (y 796-836) sits inside the language-onboarding bar band (y 787-844) — it visually collides with the bar; unlike MiniCart it does not consume the --dp-lang-bar offset.

issues: /customers returns 200 but renders the LOGIN screen ('Log in — Welcome back, sign in to manage your payments and payouts', Continue / Continue with Google / Continue with GitHub). It has no marketing content and no CTA of its own. If a 'Customers' marketing page was intended it is effectively missing; note it is not linked from the header or footer.

None of the home-page body CTAs (audience door cards, product feature cards, Learn/Docs cards, hero claim button, Final-CTA buttons) expose a data-testid; tests had to fall back to nth() on div[role=button]. Add data-testid to these for stable regression testing.

per_cta_results.footer: All 14 internal links PASS (/#features scrolls; /fees, /documentation, /system-status, /blog, /help-support, /terms-conditions, /privacy-policy, /for/ecommerce, /for/saas, /for/gaming, /for/freelancers, /for/remittance, /for/digital-downloads). 4 social links are external (x/instagram/linkedin/facebook, target=_blank, not clicked).

marketing_pages./fees 'Calculate my fee': PASS (in-page scroll 0->1491 to the calculator — no navigation by design)
marketing_pages./customers: No marketing CTA — page is the login screen (see design_issues)

regressions.MiniCart FAB not blocked by language bar: PASS — add-to-cart worked, elementFromPoint at FAB centre = the FAB's own 'View cart' text, normal (non-forced) click succeeded, minicart-drawer opened with the $100 line item and 'Pay with crypto' CTA
regressions.Socials label full creator name (/devhub: PASS — creator-socials-block reads 'FIND THE DEV STORE ON'

action_items: Fix the z-index/position collision: global ScrollToTopButton (zIndex tooltip+1) covers the support-chat FAB (zIndex 1451) and makes it unclickable on every page once scrolled >300px.
Remove the duplicate page-local 'Back to top' Fab in pages/documentation.tsx (two identical up-arrow buttons render).
Make ScrollToTopButton respect the --dp-lang-bar offset on mobile so it doesn't sit inside the language-onboarding bar.
Decide what /customers should be — it currently renders the login screen with no marketing content.
Add data-testid to home-page CTAs (audience doors, feature cards, learn cards, hero claim button, final CTA buttons) for stable regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollToTopButton.tsx uses theme.zIndex.tooltip + 1 (~1501) while SupportChatWidget uses 1451 and MiniCart 1600 — the floating-layer z-index/offset budget is ad-hoc and already causing an unclickable CTA. Centralise the bottom-right FAB stack (single container or shared constants + --dp-lang-bar offset) instead of per-component magic numbers.
The /for/[vertical] dynamic route correctly 404s unknown slugs (/for/nonprofits -> 404) while all linked verticals return 200; no dead links found there.

Home CTA handlers are a mix of router.push on div[role=button] and real <Link>/href anchors. The router.push cards are not real anchors, so they cannot be middle-clicked/opened in a new tab and are invisible to crawlers — consider using next/link for AudienceDoorsV3, ProductFeatureCards and LearnDocsCards.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of 60+ audited CTAs navigate/scroll correctly; 2 floating-button overlay/duplication defects found

seed_data_creation: None (public pages only). Hero claim test reserved handles 'qatester2026' and 'mobqa2026' via the public reserve-handle endpoint (Redis TTL lock, self-expiring).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Every landing/marketing CTA was verified working on https://dynopay-setup-8.preview.emergentagent.com — the user's 'majority of CTAs not working' report is NOT reproducible here (they were almost certainly on the dead d6d663a8 URL). Do not re-audit these CTAs unless the pages change; instead re-verify: (1) support-chat FAB clickability after the z-index fix, (2) duplicate back-to-top on /documentation. Warm routes with curl first — dev-mode Next.js compiles each route on first visit. Selector notes: header mega items = [data-testid='mega-item-<i18nKey>'] after hovering [data-testid='nav-<section>']; mobile = mobile-menu-toggle -> mnav-<section> -> msub-<i18nKey>; home body cards have no testids (use #use-cases/#features div[role=button]).
rca_of_the_issue: Reported bug (dead CTAs) not reproducible — all targets return 200 and all click handlers navigate. Newly found overlay bug RCA: ScrollToTopButton renders fixed at bottom:32/right:24 with zIndex theme.zIndex.tooltip+1 (~1501); SupportChatWidget's FAB is fixed at the same corner with zIndex 1451 and a 56px box, so the 40px scroll-to-top button overlaps the chat FAB's centre and swallows the pointer event once scrollY > 300.
